scalars.scalar_value: Completion of recognized HVAC&R apprenticeship program of at least two years' duration and four years of experience maintaining and troubleshooting industrial or large commercial heating, air conditioning and refrigeration systems, including two years of experience with the use of building management systems and building automation and control units.

items.item_text: resume
transcripts

01. PLEASE READ THE FOLLOWING STATEMENT: Answer the following questions as truthfully and accurately as possible. You are not expected to answer at the highest level of each of these items to be qualified. The application will be evaluated for minimum qualifications. Your responses to the supplemental questions below may also be used to determine your qualifications beyond the minimum qualification requirements for this classification in a training and experience (T&E) evaluation. Referring to your application/resume, listing "see resume", or incomplete responses will NOT qualify as a response to any question. Questions that are answered in this method will be considered INCOMPLETE and may result in DISQUALIFICATION. You are required to answer ALL of the supplemental questions as truthfully and accurately as possible. Your responses to these questions are subject to verification and may be assessed in subsequent examination parts. All experience, education, training, and certification must be included in your application in order to be considered. Any sign of deliberate misinformation or intentional exaggeration will result in disqualification from this examination process and possible bar from future employment opportunities with the Ventura County Community College District (VCCCD). Select "Yes" if you have read, understood, and agree to the above statements. Select "No" if you have read, understood, and DO NOT agree with the above statements and voluntarily withdraw your application for this position. Options: Yes | No

02. Which of the following best describes the number of years of HVAC&R apprenticeship you have completed. Options: No formal HVAC&R apprenticeship completed | One-year HVAC&R apprenticeship program | Two-year HVAC&R apprenticeship program | Three-year HVAC&R apprenticeship program | Four-year HVAC&R apprenticeship program

03. Do you possess a valid EPA-approved refrigerant recovery certification, Type II or Universal level, in accordance with EPA Rule 608, Clean Air Act? Options: Yes (Please attach a copy with your application) | No
04. Do you possess a current, valid California Driver License? Options: Yes | No

05. How many years of experience do you have maintaining and troubleshooting industrial or large commercial heating, air conditioning and refrigeration systems that includes the use of building management systems and building automation and control units? Options: No experience | Less than 1 year | At least 1 year but less than 2 years | At least 2 years but less than 3 years | At least 3 years but less than 4 years | At least 4 years but less than 5 years | At least 5 years but less than 6 years | At least 6 years but less than 7 years | 7 or more years

06. Which of the following best describes the size of the industrial or commercial HVAC&R systems you have experience maintaining and troubleshooting? (Select all that apply) Options: 5 - 9 tons | 10 - 14 tons | 15 - 19 tons | 20 or more tons | No experience

07. Describe your experience maintaining and troubleshooting industrial or large commercial heating, air conditioning and refrigeration systems that includes the use of building management systems and building automation control units. Please include in your response: A) the duration of your experience, B) the organization(s) in which you gained the experience, C) specific examples of tasks you performed that best illustrate your level of expertise. If you have no such experience, please mark N/A.

08. Describe your journey-level experience maintaining and configuring computer-operated direct digital control (DDC) systems, Automated Logic controls, and/or other related proprietary systems (e.g., Carrier, Trane, and York), and integration with BACnet or similar software. Please include in your response: A) the duration of your experience, B) the organization(s) in which you gained the experience, C) the manufacturer of the control system and/or software, and D) specific examples of tasks you performed that best illustrate your level of expertise. If you have no such experience, please mark N/A.

09. Describe your journey-level experience performing mechanical testing, repairs, or calibration adjustments to HVAC&R equipment. Please include in your response: A) the duration of your experience, B) the organization(s) in which you gained the experience, C) the name of the manufacturer and model of the equipment you tested, repaired, or calibrated and D) specific examples of tasks you performed that best illustrate your level of expertise. If you have no such experience, please mark N/A.

10. Describe your journey-level experience using each of the following: control and ladder diagrams, schematics, plans, and HVAC electrical wiring diagrams. Please include in your response: A) the duration of your experience, B) the organization(s) in which you gained the experience, and C) specific examples that best illustrate your level of expertise with each. If you have no such experience, please mark N/A.

11. Describe your experience preparing and/or maintaining records and reports such as: work orders, labor, materials and cost estimates. Please include in your response: A) the duration of your experience, B) the organization(s) in which you gained the experience, and C) specific examples of records and reports you have completed that best illustrate your level of expertise. If you have no such experience, please mark N/A.

12. Please list any formal training, coursework or certifications you have completed relevant to the position of HVAC&R Technician. In your response, please include a) the name of the institution(s) where the coursework, training, or certification was completed, b) the title of the courses, trainings, or certifications and c) any formal certifications obtained. If you have not completed any such coursework, trainings, or certifications, please mark N/A.

13. Candidates who are successful in this examination process may be contacted for future employment opportunities (within this classification) that may be at a different site than where the current vacancy is located. Which locations within VCCCD are you willing to work? (Check all that apply.) You will only be considered for vacancies at locations at which you indicate you are willing to work in response to this question. Options: District Administrative Center (DAC) | Moorpark College | Oxnard College | Ventura College

14. Please indicate the type of job (fulltime and/or part-time) AND the type of work (regular and/or temporary) that you are willing to accept. (Check all that apply). You will only be considered for vacancies with the type of job AND work that you are willing to accept. Options: Full Time Job | Part Time Job | Regular/Permanent Work | Temporary Work

15. The testing process will require access to a computer with a camera, microphone, speakers, and a reliable connection to the internet. If you do not have access to one or more of these components and would like to request alternate testing accommodations, please indicate so below. Options: I do NOT have access to one or more of the required components and would like to request alternate testing accommodations. | I have access to ALL of the required components and do not need alternate testing accommodations.
LICENSES AND OTHER REQUIREMENTS:

Completion of recognized HVAC&R apprenticeship program of at least two years' duration and four years of experience maintaining and troubleshooting industrial or large commercial heating, air conditioning and refrigeration systems, including two years of experience with the use of building management systems and building automation and control units.

Completion of recognized HVAC&R apprenticeship program of at least three years’ duration and three years of experience maintaining and troubleshooting industrial or large commercial heating, air conditioning, and refrigeration systems, including two years of experience with the use of building management systems and building automation and control units.

Completion of a recognized HVAC&R apprenticeship program of at least four years’ duration and two years of experience maintaining and troubleshooting industrial or large commercial heating, air conditioning, and refrigeration systems, including two years of experience with the use of building management systems and building automation and control units.

Service, maintain , calibrate, adjust, inspect, diagnose, and repair heating, ventilation, air conditioning , and refrigeration (HVAC&R) systems including boilers, cooling towers, water chillers, pumps, freezers, refrigerators, air conveyance systems , fans, gas heaters , chemical and mechanical water treatment equipment, and complex hydronic systems using direct digital or analog control device s . Test and perform water treatment in close d loop and cooling tower systems t o maintain proper chemical levels. E
Troubleshoot, repair, replace, and maintain various components ( e.g. sensors, relays, etc.) connected to/ interfaced with a building automation system (BAS) . E

Monitor and adjust levels of fluids/gasses in HVAC&R systems ; u tilize refrigerant scales and recovery units to add and remove refrigerant from air conditioning and refrigeration units; pressure test refrigerant systems using industry approved methods to find and stop leaks and evacuate, store , and replace refrigerants ; repair or replace and purge compressors on chillers . E

E nsure compliance with applicable federal, state and local laws, rules, and regulations in the purchase, use , containment , and disposal of hazardous materials, fluids, and gases ; m aintain accurate records of refrigerant movement; submit records to appropriate agencies as requested ; maintain service records. E

Perform electrical, pneumatic , hydronic, and mechanical testing of equipment ; d iagnose mechanical and electrical problems; repair or replace defective parts in units and equipment and controls; calibrate and adjust temperature controls . E
Rebuild or replace various HVAC&R components including but not limited to water pumps, air conditioning compressors , and air compressors. E
Perform brazing, soldering , and welding as needed . E

Assist with performing skilled maintenance, repair, and construction of campus facilities and equipment in the basic trades including carpentry, painting, electrical, locksmith, welding, masonry, glazing, and plumbing; assist other skilled trade workers as assigned. E
Prepare and maintain a variety of records and reports related to work orders, labor, and materials. E
Estimate cost, labor, and materials; order materials according to established guidelines ; maintain HVAC&R tools and equipment . E
Provide work direction to others as assigned. E
Participate in technical trainings as required . E
Work collaboratively and professionally with faculty, staff, students, and stakeholders from diverse academic, socioeconomic, cultural, disability, gender identity, and ethnic communities. E
Demonstrate cultural humility, sensitivity, and equity-mindedness in working with individuals from diverse communities; model inclusive behaviors; and achieve equity in assignment-related outcomes. E
Perform related duties as assigned.
